$comment: Robot map: the translation between what the robot code believes it has (channels, CAN IDs) and what exists in the SDF (joints, links). It is the only thing that changes from one robot to another; the engine and the bridge are generic. One of these files per robot, in sim/models/<robot>/robot-map.json.
$comment_profile: vendor = the motors are CAN (TalonFX/SparkMax) and the robot code needs the glue. hal = everything is roboRIO-native PWM/DIO and the loop is transparent over wpilibws. See README.
$comment_actuators: gearRatio is a reduction: motor turns per output turn. The wheel radius does NOT go here, it comes from the SDF's collision geometry, which is the only source the physics respects.
$comment_encoders: countsPerRevolution is measured on the MOTOR SHAFT, before the reduction, which is how the integrated encoders of Falcon/Kraken report it. The bridge multiplies by the gearRatio of the actuator that shares the joint.
$comment_imu: The link has to exist in the SDF and carry a <sensor type="imu">. simDevice is the EXACT name WPILib registers the device under; if it does not match, the robot code reads zeros and there is no error anywhere.
